_comment: The T-0 gate of the experiment {{name}}: what must hold seconds before the trial.
Each entry is either a machine check ({text, check, args}) or a plain string the
operator confirms. A check is a script of the package, of the backend, or of this
project's experiments/common/preflight/checks/ (the project's wins). Its exit code
decides: 0 PASS, 1 FAIL, 3 SKIP. A text starting with [HARD] cannot be overridden by
the operator. ${name} in an argument is filled from the trial's factor values. Checks
run after the stack is started, so they measure the real processes of this trial.

checklist.text: [HARD] The recording directory is writable on the machine that records.

checklist: Operator: the system and the recording are the ones this trial declares (a plain string is confirmed by the operator).
